content:
I'm bumping my PRs since it's been a month (I know everyone is busy, no pressure).
There is #43406 to mathlib4 and https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib-ci/pull/68 to the ci.

For PRs that add crossreference tags, they add a comment with a table with links to the lean and the corresponding external database entry side by side. This was stated as a desiderata in past PR reviews.

The actual changes are fairly small since 80%+ of the code [this is a made up number, "a lot"] can be copied over from the existing declDiff workflow.

They should make it much easier to review PRs like #43907, of which presumably there should be more of in the future as the number of linked databases grows (eg. #44368), plus the upcoming lmfdb workshop, etc. I'd like to contribute more infrastructure for cross-referencing in general and this is a quick first step.
I pinky promise to be very reactive to reviews
The CI PRs are on my list, but I haven't gotten around to them yet, sorry for keeping you waiting!
No problem, I was hoping for someone to swoop in and save us. I can imagine you are quite busy
